notes.title: Patch #1: Operation S.L.A.M.M.E.R. Update
notes.content:

Welcome rebels to our very first patch notes! These will be short but we'll try to keep these updated on a regular cadence as we add content to the demo and improve the flow of the game with your feedback. 

This patch introduces our new boss system that lets you check select a boss and assign a difficulty to make the game easier or more challenging. Additionally there been some minor changes under the hood, generally improving performance and making some balance tweaks. 

-New boss selection system
-New difficulty options
-Performance tweaks
-More bugs to fix later

Please share your feedback as that helps make the game so much better!
[b]Feedback form[/b]: https://forms.gle/o86BriLxkYnnBLUi6


Until next time rebels, stay safe and keep resisting!
